name: color-code
description: /color colors the whole terminal tab per Claude Code session (background, palette, Windows Terminal tab and title bar), or with /color dynamic follows Claude's state: yellow working, blue needs you, green done, red failed. Windows Terminal, macOS and Linux.

activity.title: Color Code's own tab ring
activity.description: Draw Color Code's tab progress ring (working / waiting on you / idle) instead of leaving Claude Code's own. Windows Terminal, ConEmu and Ghostty. Off by default: the two rings would fight.

autoColor.title: Auto color per project
autoColor.description: Give a session nobody colored a stable color picked from its project folder.
